summary: Master central bank leadership ethics and the IMF Transparency Code. Build institutional trust through practical governance and integrity frameworks.
lede: Ethics and Integrity in Central Bank Leadership equips professionals to identify integrity risks, manage conflicts of interest, protect sensitive market information, and keep policy decisions free from undue influence. The course translates moral principles and transparency expectations into practical governance standards for institutions operating under intense public scrutiny. You will develop tools for integrity audits, disclosure frameworks, cooling-off policies, ethical AI oversight, and whistleblowing cultures. You will also work with the IMF Central Bank Transparency Code, OECD Public Integrity Framework, BIS governance guidelines, and ISO 37001 anti-bribery management systems to turn institutional values into measurable practice.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for senior professionals who hold fiduciary responsibilities and must model the highest standards of conduct within a monetary authority.
audience: Central Bank Governors and Deputy Governors
modules: Integrity in Financial Supervision and Regulation
Ethics of Digital Transformation and AI
prerequisites: Participants should hold a senior management or policy-making role within a central bank, ministry of finance, or financial regulatory authority. A foundational understanding of central bank governance and monetary policy operations is required. No prior specialization in ethics or compliance is necessary, though familiarity with the IMF Central Bank Transparency Code is beneficial.
